appearance: Lupenor Celest is a strawberry-to-orange-haired elven archer of Desna—sharp-eyed, quick-smiling, and chaotically brave—whose Trickster mythic power turns impossible escapes into routine. Equal parts merchant’s daughter and crusade legend, she scouts ahead with a bow on her back and the weight of Drezen’s survival on her shoulders.\n

id-00001.benefit: You gain a +1 dodge bonus to your AC. A condition that makes you lose your Dex bonus to AC also makes you lose the benefits of this feat.
id-00001.name: Dodge

id-00002.benefit: You get a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with ranged weapons at ranges of up to 30 feet.
id-00002.flavor: You are especially accurate when making ranged attacks against close targets.
id-00002.name: Point Blank Shot (+1/+1, 30ft)
id-00002.summary: +1 attack and damage on targets within 30 feet

id-00003.benefit: You can shoot or throw ranged weapons at an opponent engaged in melee without taking the standard -4 penalty on your attack roll.
id-00003.name: Precise Shot (+4, Melee)
id-00003.special: A fighter may select Precise Shot as one of his fighter bonus feats.
id-00003.summary: No -4 penalty for shooting into melee

id-00004.benefit:
Whenever you're below 0 hit points, you automatically stabilize. You don't die until your total negative HP is equal to 2x Cont.

If you can act below 0 HP, you can still lose points from actions. Bleed damage still affects HP.
id-00004.name: Hard to kill
id-00004.summary: When you hit 0 HP, you automatically stabilize.
id-00004.text: Whenever you're below 0 hit points, you automatically stabilize without needing to attempt a Constitution check. If you have an ability that allows you to act while below 0 hit points, you still lose hit points for taking actions, as specified by that ability. Bleed damage still causes you to lose hit points when below 0 hit points. In addition, you don't die until your total number of negative hit points is equal to or greater than double your Constitution score.

id-00005.name: Trapfinding
id-00005.summary: Disable Device is now a Class Skill. Gain Trapfinding and Trap Sense Rogue Skills.\n\nTrapfinding: Gain a 1/2 Level bonus on Perception Checks made to find traps and Disable Device checks to disable traps. Can disarm magic traps.
id-00005.text: A rogue adds 1/2 her level to Perception skill checks made to locate traps and to Disable Device skill checks (minimum +1). A rogue can use Disable Device to disarm magic traps.

id-00006.name: Trap sense (+2)
id-00006.summary: A Rogue gains an intuitive sense that alerts them to danger from traps. Gain +1 on Reflex Saves to Avoid Traps. Gain +1 Dodge Bonus to AC on Trap Attacks. \n\nAdd +1 at levels 6, 9, 12, 15, and 18. Stacks with other Trap Senses from other classes.
id-00006.text: At 3rd level, a rogue gains an intuitive sense that alerts her to danger from traps, giving her a +1 bonus on Reflex saves made to avoid traps and a +1 dodge bonus to AC against attacks made by traps. These bonuses rise to +2 when the rogue reaches 6th level, to +3 when she reaches 9th level, to +4 when she reaches 12th level, to +5 at 15th, and to +6 at 18th level.Trap sense bonuses gained from multiple classes stack.

id-00007.benefit: Your ranged attacks ignore the AC bonus granted to targets by anything less than total cover, and the miss chance granted to targets by anything less than total concealment. Total cover and total concealment provide their normal benefits against your ranged attacks.
id-00007.name: Improved Precise Shot
id-00007.normal: See the normal rules on the effects of cover and concealment in Combat.
id-00007.prerequisites: Dex 19, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, base attack bonus +11.
id-00007.summary: No cover or concealment chance on ranged attacks

id-00008.name: Chance encounter
id-00008.summary: Gain +2 on Reflex Saves.\n\nUse 1 Mythic Power to gain a 20 on Acrobatics, Bluff, Disguise, Sleight of Hand, or Stealth check. Does not increase time taken.
id-00008.text: The PC gains a +2 trait bonus on Reflex saves. By expending one use of mythic power, the PC can take 20 on an Acrobatics, Bluff, Disguise, Sleight of Hand, or Stealth check without an increase in the time required to make the check.

id-00009.name: Opportunist
id-00009.special: Combat Reflexes does not allow multiple Attacks of Opportunity.
id-00009.summary: 1 time per round, when an enemy is struck with an ally's melee attack, you can make an Attack of Opportunity against that enemy.
id-00009.text: Once per round, the rogue can make an attack of opportunity against an opponent who has just been struck for damage in melee by another character. This attack counts as an attack of opportunity for that round. Even a rogue with the Combat Reflexes feat can't use the opportunist ability more than once per round.

id-00010.benefit:
You can draw a weapon as a free action instead of as a move action. You can draw a hidden weapon (see the Sleight of Hand skill) as a move action.

A character who has selected this feat may throw weapons at his full normal rate of attacks (much like a character with a bow).
id-00010.name: Quick Draw
id-00010.normal: Without this feat, you may draw a weapon as a move action, or (if your base attack bonus is +1 or higher) as a free action as part of movement. Without this feat, you can draw a hidden weapon as a standard action.
id-00010.special: A fighter may select Quick Draw as one of his fighter bonus feats.

id-00013.benefit: When making a full-attack action with a ranged weapon, you can fire one additional time this round. All of your attack rolls take a -2 penalty when using Rapid Shot.
id-00013.name: Rapid Shot

id-00015.benefit: You can choose to take a -1 penalty on all ranged attack rolls to gain a +2 bonus on all ranged damage rolls. When your base attack bonus reaches +4, and every +4 thereafter, the penalty increases by -1 and the bonus to damage increases by +2. You must choose to use this feat before making an attack roll and its effects last until your next turn. The bonus damage does not apply to touch attacks or effects that do not deal hit point damage.
id-00015.name: Deadly Aim (-3/+6)
id-00015.summary: Trade ranged attack bonus for damage

id-00016.benefit: You get a +4 bonus on initiative checks.
id-00016.flavor: Your quick reflexes allow you to react rapidly to danger.
id-00016.name: Improved Initiative

id-00002.description: This bright silver or gold +3 chainmail is so fine and light that it can be worn under normal clothing without betraying its presence. It has a maximum Dexterity bonus of +8, an armor check penalty of -2, and an arcane spell failure chance of 15%. It is considered light armor, weighs 20 pounds, and it allows the wearer to use fly on command (as the spell) once per day.
id-00002.name: +3 Celestial Armor
id-00002.prerequisites: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, creator must be good, fly

id-00004.description:
A chime of opening is a hollow mithral tube about 1 foot long. When struck, it sends forth magical vibrations that cause locks, lids, doors, valves, and portals to open. The device functions against normal bars, shackles, chains, bolts, and so on. A chime of opening also automatically dispels a hold portal spell or even an arcane lock cast by a wizard of lower than 15th level.

The chime must be pointed at the item or gate to be loosed or opened (which must be visible and known to the user). The chime is then struck and a clear tone rings forth. The wielder can make a caster level check against the lock or binding, using the chime's caster level of 11th. The DC of this check is equal to the Disable Device DC to open the lock or binding. Each sounding only opens one form of locking, so if a chest is chained, padlocked, locked, and arcane locked , it takes four successful uses of a chime of opening to get it open. A silence spell negates the power of the device. A brandnew chime can be used a total of 10 times before it cracks and becomes useless.
id-00004.name: Chime of Opening [10  charges]

id-00005.description: This longsword has an enhancement bonus of +1 on the Material Plane, but on any Elemental Plane its enhancement bonus increases to +2. The +2 enhancement bonus also applies on the Material Plane when the weapon is used against elementals. It operates as a +3 longsword on the Astral Plane or the Ethereal Plane or when used against opponents native to either of those planes. On any other plane, or against any outsider, it functions as a +4 longsword .
id-00005.name: Sword of the Planes | +1 Longsword
id-00005.prerequisites: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, plane shift

id-00006.description: A potion is a magic liquid that produces its effect when imbibed. A potion can be used only once.
id-00006.name: Potion of Enlarge Person

id-00008.description:
An arrow used as a melee weapon is treated as a light improvised weapon (-4 penalty on attack rolls) and deals damage as a dagger of its size (critical multiplier ×2).

Arrows come in a leather quiver that holds 20 arrows.
id-00008.name: Arrows

id-00009.description: A torch burns for 1 hour, shedding normal light in a 20-foot radius and increasing the light level by one step for an additional 20 feet beyond that area (darkness becomes dim light and dim light becomes normal light). A torch does not increase the light level in normal light or bright light. If a torch is used in combat, treat it as a one-handed improvised weapon that deals bludgeoning damage equal to that of a gauntlet of its size, plus 1 point of fire damage.
id-00009.name: Torch

id-00010.description: Lighting a torch with f lint and steel is a full-round action, and lighting any other fire with them takes at least that long.
id-00010.name: Flint and steel

id-00011.description: A potion is a magic liquid that produces its effect when imbibed. A potion can be used only once.
id-00011.name: Potion of Cure Moderate Wounds

id-00012.description:
You need at least two hands to use a bow, regardless of its size. You can use a composite longbow while mounted. All composite bows are made with a particular strength rating (that is, each requires a minimum Strength modifier to use with proficiency). If your Strength bonus is less than the strength rating of the composite bow, you can't effectively use it, so you take a -2 penalty on attacks with it. The default composite longbow requires a Strength modifier of +0 or higher to use with proficiency. A composite longbow can be made with a high strength rating to take advantage of an above-average Strength score; this feature allows you to add your Strength bonus to damage, up to the maximum bonus indicated for the bow. Each point of Strength bonus granted by the bow adds 100 gp to its cost. If you have a penalty for low Strength, apply it to damage rolls when you use a composite longbow.

For purposes of Weapon Proficiency and similar feats, a composite longbow is treated as if it were a longbow.
id-00012.name: +2 Composite Longbow (+4 Str)

id-00013.description:
These palm-sized silver dragon scales are unique items - essentially minor artifacts resulting from Terendelev's death on the Storm King's blade.

Each of Terendelev's scales grants a different power to the person who carries them. The powers granted do not function at all if more than one scale is carried. The powers of the four scales are listed below - any nonevil creature that handles a scale immediately understands its use.

Sacred Weaponry: Three times per day as a standard action, a scale can be used to cast align weapon, but only to make a weapon lawful or good. Unlike a normal align weapon spell, this effect can be cast on an unarmed strike or natural weapon.

Destruction

The Storm King Khorramzadeh can destroy each of Terendelev's scales merely by eating it.
id-00013.name: Terendelev's Scale (Sacred Weaponry)

id-00014.description: A potion is a magic liquid that produces its effect when imbibed. A potion can be used only once.
id-00014.name: Potion of Divine Favor

id-00015.description: This divine food comes in many forms, from a light and airy honeyed cake to a deep, rich chocolate. A mythic creature that eats this food is restored and replenished. Eating this food takes 1 minute, and when the meal is done, the consumer regains all her uses of mythic power for the day. If a nonmythic creature consumes ambrosia, that creature is subject to neutralize poison, remove curse, and remove disease, each at caster level 10th. A mythic creature can choose to either gain this effect instead of regaining mythic power.
id-00015.name: Ambrosia
id-00015.prerequisites: Craft Wondrous Item, Mythic Crafter, greater heroism, heal

id-00016.description: A potion is a magic liquid that produces its effect when imbibed. A potion can be used only once.
id-00016.name: Potion of Fly

id-00018.description: A potion is a magic liquid that produces its effect when imbibed. A potion can be used only once.
id-00018.name: Potion of Cure Light Wounds

id-00020.description: This ring offers continual magical protection in the form of a deflection bonus of +1 to +5 to AC.
id-00020.name: Ring of Protection +1
id-00020.prerequisites: Forge Ring, shield of faith, caster must be of a level at least three times greater than the bonus of the ring

id-00021.description:
An arrow used as a melee weapon is treated as a light improvised weapon (-4 penalty on attack rolls) and deals damage as a dagger of its size (critical multiplier ×2).

Arrows come in a leather quiver that holds 20 arrows.
id-00021.name: Cold Iron Arrows

id-00024.description: The alchemical substance on the end of this small, wooden stick ignites when struck against a rough surface. Creating a f lame with a tindertwig is much faster than creating a f lame with f lint and steel (or a magnifying glass) and tinder. Lighting a torch with a tindertwig is a standard action (rather than a full-round action), and lighting any other fire with one is at least a standard action.
id-00024.name: Tindertwig

id-00025.description:
The call of this hollowed-out animal horn rallies nearby creatures to battle. When the horn is blown, all creatures within 60 feet who have not yet acted in combat are no longer considered flat-footed. The horn has no effect on other conditions or abilities that treat a creature as flat-footed.

A barbarian who sounds a horn of battle clarity may spend 2 rounds of rage to act as if she had the superstition rage power for the remainder of that battle.
id-00025.name: Horn of Battle Clarity

id-00026.description: These soft boots enable the wearer to move nimbly about in virtually any surroundings, granting a +5 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks.
id-00026.name: Boots of Elvenkind
id-00026.prerequisites: Craft Wondrous Item, creator must be an elf

id-00027.description: This belt's golden buckle depicts a bear. The belt grants the wearer an enhancement bonus to Constitution of +2, +4, or +6.Treat this as a temporary ability bonus for the first 24 hours the belt is worn.
id-00027.name: Belt of Mighty Constitution +4

id-00028.description:
You can throw this stone as a ranged attack with a range increment of 20 feet. When it strikes a hard surface (or is struck hard), it creates a deafening bang that is treated as a sonic attack. Each creature within a 10-foot-radius spread must make a DC 15 Fortitude save or be deafened for 1 hour. A deafened creature, in addition to the obvious effects, takes a -4 penalty on initiative and has a 20% chance to miscast and lose any spell with a verbal component that it tries to cast.

Since you don't need to hit a specific target, you can simply aim at a particular 5-foot square. Treat the target square as AC 5.
id-00028.name: Thunderstone

id-00030.description:
This small coin purse is made of supple leather and has a drawstring closure, and looks to be capable of holding up to 200 coins, however after the first 100 coins, it will always appear to be half-full, no matter how many more coins are added up to a maximum of 50,000 coins (at which point it appears to be full and no more coins can be stuffed inside).

The owner can open the drawstring, declare an amount and a denomination, and dump out that exact amount (assuming the purse contains enough money). Alternatively, the user can dip in a few fingers and extract a few coins at a time (like a normal purse).
id-00030.name: Bottomless Purse
id-00030.nonidentified: A supple leather coin purse with drawstring and a clever toggle to keep the string tight.

id-00031.description:
When the final fragment of the Kenabres wardstone shatters, a few tiny shards of the stone remain behind. The magic remaining in these fragments is fleeting, usable only once before the shard becomes an inert sliver of stone. As a standard action, a wardstone shard may be rubbed along a weapon or a suit of armor to transfer the shard's magic to the weapon or armor for 1 day.

Weapon: A weapon enhanced by a wardstone shard gains the evil outsider bane quality, and is treated as being made of cold iron and as a good weapon for the purposes of overcoming a demon's damage reduction. The shard cannot be used to enhance ammunition in this manner, but can be used to enhance a weapon that fires ammunition; doing so causes the weapon to impart these qualities to the ammunition as it is fired.

Armor: A suit of armor enhanced by a wardstone shard gains the spell resistance (13) armor special ability, but only against evil outsiders. Against demons, this spell resistance increases to 17. A nonmagical suit of armor also gains a +1 enhancement bonus as well.

Destruction

A wardstone shard may be destroyed simply by crushing it - a shard has hardness 16 and 12 hit points.
id-00031.name: Wardstone Shard

id-00032.description:
Slot: none

These ornate military medals are awarded to crusaders and adventurers who excel and deserve commendation in the war against the Worldwound. A medal must be affixed to a worn article of clothing to function, but doesn't have to be worn visibly. Any number of righteous medals can be worn, but the effects of multiple medals of a single type don't stack. A righteous medal functions only if the wearer has legitimately achieved the feat for which she received the medal. As a swift action, the wearer can gain a +2 sacred bonus to the medal's associated ability score for 1 minute. In addition, each righteous medal grants a constant sacred bonus on one type of roll, as detailed below.

Righteous Medal of Valor: This medal looks like a demonic skull, the top of which has been pierced by four red-hilted swords. It is awarded to a hero who delivers a death blow to a demon whose CR is at least 1 higher than the hero's character level. This medal is associated with Strength and grants a +2 sacred bonus to CMD.

A mythic character who wears all six righteous medals gains one additional use of mythic power per day.
id-00032.name: Righteous Medal of Valor
id-00032.prerequisites: Craft Wondrous Item, bless, bull's strength

id-00033.description:
Slot: none

These ornate military medals are awarded to crusaders and adventurers who excel and deserve commendation in the war against the Worldwound. A medal must be affixed to a worn article of clothing to function, but doesn't have to be worn visibly. Any number of righteous medals can be worn, but the effects of multiple medals of a single type don't stack. A righteous medal functions only if the wearer has legitimately achieved the feat for which she received the medal. As a swift action, the wearer can gain a +2 sacred bonus to the medal's associated ability score for 1 minute. In addition, each righteous medal grants a constant sacred bonus on one type of roll, as detailed below.

Righteous Medal of Clarity: This circular blue medal depicts a pair of feminine gray eyes surrounded by a circular silver lightning bolt. It is awarded to a hero who recovers vital information of great use against the Worldwound and delivers this intelligence to the crusaders. This medal is associated with Intelligence and grants a +2 sacred bonus on saves against insanity or confusion effects.

A mythic character who wears all six righteous medals gains one additional use of mythic power per day.
id-00033.name: Righteous Medal of Clarity
id-00033.prerequisites: Craft Wondrous Item, bless, fox's cunning

id-00034.description: These garments offer magic protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).
id-00034.name: Cloak of Resistance +2
id-00034.prerequisites: Craft Wondrous Item, resistance, creator's caster level must be at least three times the cloak's bonus

id-00035.description: This amulet, usually crafted from bone or beast scales, toughens the wearer's body and flesh, giving him an enhancement bonus to his natural armor bonus of from +1 to +5, depending on the kind of amulet.
id-00035.name: Amulet of Natural Armor +1
id-00035.prerequisites: Craft Wondrous Item, barkskin, creator's caster level must be at least three times the amulet's bonus

id-00036.description: This otherwise normal torch has a continual flame spell cast on it. This causes it to shed light like an ordinary torch, but it does not emit heat or deal fire damage if used as a weapon.
id-00036.name: Everburning Torch

id-00037.description:
Slot: none

These ornate military medals are awarded to crusaders and adventurers who excel and deserve commendation in the war against the Worldwound. A medal must be affixed to a worn article of clothing to function, but doesn't have to be worn visibly. Any number of righteous medals can be worn, but the effects of multiple medals of a single type don't stack. A righteous medal functions only if the wearer has legitimately achieved the feat for which she received the medal. As a swift action, the wearer can gain a +2 sacred bonus to the medal's associated ability score for 1 minute. In addition, each righteous medal grants a constant sacred bonus on one type of roll, as detailed below.

Righteous Medal of Agility: This triangular iron medal shows a demonic face surrounded by three swords. It is awarded to a hero who delivers a death blow to a demon in combat before that demon gets a chance to act in the combat. This medal is associated with Dexterity and grants a +1 sacred bonus on Initiative checks.

A mythic character who wears all six righteous medals gains one additional use of mythic power per day.
id-00037.name: Righteous Medal of Agility
id-00037.prerequisites: Craft Wondrous Item, bless, cat's grace

id-00038.description:
This +1 arrow is keyed to a particular type or subtype of creature. If it strikes such a creature, the target must make a DC 20 Fortitude save or take 50 points of damage. Note that even creatures normally exempt from Fortitude saves (undead and constructs) are subject to this attack. When keyed to a living creature, this is a death effect (and thus death ward protects a target). To determine the type or subtype of creature the arrow is keyed to, roll on the table below.

d% Designated Type or Subtype
01-05 Aberrations
06-09 Animals
10-16 Constructs
17-27 Dragons
28-32 Fey

91-98 Undead
99-100 Vermin
id-00038.name: Human Slaying Arrow
id-00038.prerequisites: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, finger of death (Slaying arrow) or heightened finger of death (greater slaying arrow)

id-00039.description:
Essentially a longer version of a scimitar, but with a thinner blade, the elven curve blade is exceptionally rare. You receive a +2 circumstance bonus to your CMD whenever a foe attempts to sunder your elven curve blade because of its flexible metal.

You can use the Weapon Finesse feat to apply your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier on attack rolls with an elven curve blade that is sized for you, even though it isn't a light weapon.
id-00039.name: +1 Elven Curve Blade

id-00040.description: A kukri is a curved blade, about 1 foot in length.
id-00040.name: Kukri

id-00041.description: This appears to be a typical arrow container capable of holding about 20 arrows. It has three distinct portions, each with a nondimensional space allowing it to store far more than would normally be possible. The first and smallest one can contain up to 60 objects of the same general size and shape as an arrow. The second slightly longer compartment holds up to 18 objects of the same general size and shape as a javelin. The third and longest portion of the case contains as many as 6 objects of the same general size and shape as a bow (spears, staffs, or the like). Once the owner has filled it, the quiver can quickly produce any item she wishes that is within the quiver, as if from a regular quiver or scabbard. The efficient quiver weighs the same no matter what's placed inside it.
id-00041.name: Efficient Quiver

id-00042.description:
An arrow used as a melee weapon is treated as a light improvised weapon (-4 penalty on attack rolls) and deals damage as a dagger of its size (critical multiplier ×2).

Arrows come in a leather quiver that holds 20 arrows.
id-00042.name: +2 Magical Beast Bane Arrow

id-00043.description: This bag is made of an animal bladder or treated leather. It is watertight and holds about 1/2 gallon of liquid. The listed weight is for a waterskin full of water; empty, it weighs about 2 pounds.
id-00043.name: Waterskin

id-00045.description: A potion is a magic liquid that produces its effect when imbibed. A potion can be used only once.
id-00045.name: Potion of Neutralize Poison

id-00046.description: This is a particularly potent bottle of dwarven ale.
id-00046.name: Bottle of Dwarven Ale

id-00049.description: Drinking this elixir grants the imbiber the ability to notice acute details with great accuracy (+10 competence bonus on Perception checks for 1 hour).
id-00049.name: Elixir of Vision

id-00051.description: This ring continually provides its wearer with life-sustaining nourishment. The ring also refreshes the body and mind, so that its wearer needs only sleep 2 hours per day to gain the benefit of 8 hours of sleep. This allows a spellcaster that requires rest to prepare spells to do so after only 2 hours, but this does not allow a spellcaster to prepare spells more than once per day. The ring must be worn for a full week before it begins to work. If it is removed, the owner must wear it for another week to reattune it to himself.
id-00051.name: Ring of Sustenance
id-00051.prerequisites: Forge Ring, create food and water

id-00001.name: Mirror Dodge
id-00001.text:
On hit by an attack, burn a mythic surge as a swift action to replace yourself with a mirrored image and teleport 30 ft away.

You take no damage from the attack.

You can only teleport to a spot within eye sight.

Nerf: This ability can only be used once per combat.

id-00002.name: Trickster Attack - Surprise Strike
id-00002.text:
Use a Mythic Surge as a Swift Action to make a free attack against a creature within 30 ft.

The attack gains your mythic tier as a bonus and attacks the target as if it were flat-footed.

Damage from this attack bypasses DR.

id-00003.name: Wall Run
id-00003.text: When you move, you can travel across vertical surfaces as if they were floors. If your movement doesn't end on a horizontal surface, you fall at the end of your move unless you are able to remain in place using another ability (such as using the Climb skill to cling to a handhold). The vertical surface must be capable of supporting your weight - for example, you couldn't move across a windowpane or curtain.

id-00004.name: Vanishing Move
id-00004.text:
When you wish to not be seen, you aren't. As a swift action, you can make yourself invisible until the end of your turn. This effect ends if you do anything other than move.

If you expend one use of mythic power when using this ability, it instead acts as greater invisibility using double your tier as your caster level.

id-00001.benefit: When using Rapid Shot, you can either ignore the feat's -2 penalty on attack rolls or make two additional attacks instead of one.
id-00001.name: Rapid Shot (Mythic)
id-00001.summary: You can fire many times each round with amazing precision.

id-00002.name: Deadly Aim (Mythic)
id-00002.summary: Adds a +1 to Deadly Aim's damage per tier (-1/+3, -2/+5, ect)

id-00003.benefit:
Whenever you're below 0 hit points, you automatically stabilize. You don't die until your total negative HP is equal to 2x Cont.

If you can act below 0 HP, you can still lose points from actions. Bleed damage still affects HP.
id-00003.name: Hard to kill
id-00003.summary: When you hit 0 HP, you automatically stabilize.
id-00003.text: Whenever you're below 0 hit points, you automatically stabilize without needing to attempt a Constitution check. If you have an ability that allows you to act while below 0 hit points, you still lose hit points for taking actions, as specified by that ability. Bleed damage still causes you to lose hit points when below 0 hit points. In addition, you don't die until your total number of negative hit points is equal to or greater than double your Constitution score.

id-00004.benefit: When making a full-attack action with a bow and using Manyshot, you fire two arrows with both your first and second attacks, instead of just your first attack.
id-00004.name: Manyshot (Mythic)
id-00004.summary: You can fire a barrage of arrows at your target with very little effort.

id-00001.name: 6.01. Chance Encounter (Trickster)

shortcut.recordname: encounter.id-00123@Wrath of the Righteous AP 1 The Worldwound Incursion

By expending one use of mythic power, the PC can take 20 on an Acrobatics, Bluff, Disguise, Sleight of Hand, or Stealth check without an increase in the time required to make the check. The mysterious woman the PC encountered was in fact a disguised Arueshalae, and her act of saving the PC was the first of her conscious acts toward her redemption. This PC will have a special bond with the redeemed succubus when the party encounters her in the third adventure.

Mythic Trait: Chance Encounter

id-00003.name: Mirror Dodge
id-00003.text:
On hit by an attack, burn a mythic surge as a swift action to replace yourself with a mirrored image and teleport 30 ft away.

You take no damage from the attack.

You can only teleport to a spot within eye sight.

Nerf: This ability can only be used once per combat.

id-00004.name: Wall Run
id-00004.text: When you move, you can travel across vertical surfaces as if they were floors. If your movement doesn't end on a horizontal surface, you fall at the end of your move unless you are able to remain in place using another ability (such as using the Climb skill to cling to a handhold). The vertical surface must be capable of supporting your weight - for example, you couldn't move across a windowpane or curtain.

id-00005.name: Vanishing Move
id-00005.text:
When you wish to not be seen, you aren't. As a swift action, you can make yourself invisible until the end of your turn. This effect ends if you do anything other than move.

If you expend one use of mythic power when using this ability, it instead acts as greater invisibility using double your tier as your caster level.

id-00006.name: Pure Destiny
id-00006.text: Your mythic destiny is guided by providence. You're immune to all non-mythic curses and compulsions. Curses and compulsions from mythic sources count as mythic for the purposes of this ability.

name: Lupenor Celest
notes:
Lupenor Celest is a 110-year-old elven archer and merchant’s daughter turned crusader scout—Chaotic Good, devoted to Desna, and steadily awakening into a Trickster-shaped kind of mythic hero. She grew up straddling two lives: the Celest family’s trade caravans and ledgers, and the forests where her father taught her to hunt and shoot. When Kenabres’ City Day celebration drew her family’s stall into the open, Deskari’s invasion shattered everything, quite literally. Lupenor survived a fall into the caverns beneath the city only through the silver dragon Terendeleve’s sacrifice, and she emerged from the dark with a new family forged in crisis: Harlock Greyforge the half-orc fighter, Sir Varic Sarian the cleric of Sarenrae, and Rebiah a human sorceress. They work together to rescue anyone else injured from the fall.

In the ruins of Kenabres, Lupenor’s instincts for stealth and survival carried the party from the underground Shield Maze up to the surface and to the Defender’s Heart, where they learned the all important Wardstone that had been placed to defend the city from demons had been corrupted into a potential catastrophe. While investigating cult strongholds and gathering allies to tackle this problem, Lupenor uncovered receipts and journals that betrayed members of the Celest family were supplying weapons and disguises to cultists directly—an ugly betrayal that reshaped her purpose into something personal. The assault on the Grey Garrison pushed her past fear and into clarity; in the Wardstone chamber, The Achitech of the Worldwound herself Areelu Vorlesh’s presence and the rod of destruction triggered visions of her past, present, and future. When the Wardstone shattered, angelic power poured into the party, igniting their first mythic strength—and in Lupenor’s vision, she saw herself one day driving Areelu into the Worldwound and sealing it.

For the heroic rescue of Kenabres, the party was chosen by Queen Galfrey to lead an army and march into the Worldwound to reclaim Drezen, the Dwarven Citadel that fell to the demons in the First Crusade. Lupenor Celest marched as the army’s scout under Rebiah’s command, with Harlock leading the paladins and Varic sustaining the crusade’s spirit and supplies. The campaign was marked by victories, sabotage, and hard lessons; swarms forced Lupenor to respect melee over her trusty bow, betrayal rumors tested bonds, and Drezen itself punished every mistake with traps, illusions, and brutal close-quarters fights. In the citadel, she fell once to the defenders of the corrupted fortress, but was resurrected to fight stronger than ever before! Later, she endured a bigger horror, being Dominated in the dungeon below—turning her bow on her friend and killing Rebiah. Through luck and enginunity, Rebiah was resurrected back, but Lupenor carried the guilt like a second shadow ever since. She quickly learned she was a double edged arrow.

Despite demonic corruption, obscene blasphemies, and enemies that her arrows could barely touch, Lupenor’s caution and perception repeatedly saved the party—spotting deadly traps, dismantling illusions, and guiding them through Drezen’s lowest depths. They stopped a cult ritual, cleansed the maddening voices that plagued the prison, and finally confronted a greater shadow demon that had haunted the citadel for a century. With the help of true seeing and holy power, Harlock and the party destroyed it, triggering another surge of mythic energy. After retrieving the true crimson Sword of Valor banner, securing Drezen and warding against demonic teleportation while giving the crusade a symbol to rally behind.

id-00003.name: Swift tracker
id-00003.text: At 11th level, a slayer can move at his normal speed while using Survival to follow tracks without taking the normal -5 penalty. When moving at up to twice his normal speed while tracking, he takes only a -10 penalty instead of the normal -20.

id-00004.name: Sneak attack (4) (4d6)
id-00004.text:
At 3rd level, if a slayer catches an opponent unable to defend itself effectively from his attack, he can strike a vital spot for extra damage. The slayer's attack deals extra damage anytime his target would be denied a Dexterity bonus to AC (whether the target actually has a Dexterity bonus or not), or when the slayer flanks his target. This additional damage is 1d6 at 3rd level, and increases by 1d6 every 3 levels thereafter. Should the slayer score a critical hit with a sneak attack, this additional damage is not multiplied. Ranged attacks can count as sneak attacks only if the target is within 30 feet.

With a weapon that deals nonlethal damage (like a sap, whip, or unarmed strike), a slayer can make a sneak attack that deals nonlethal damage instead of lethal damage. He cannot use a weapon that deals lethal damage to deal nonlethal damage in a sneak attack, not even with the usual -4 penalty.

The slayer must be able to see the target well enough to pick out a vital spot and must be able to reach such a spot. A slayer cannot use sneak attack while striking a creature with concealment.

id-00005.name: Mirror Dodge
id-00005.text: When hit by a melee or ranged attack, you can expend one use of mythic power as an immediate action to replace yourself with an illusory duplicate and teleport to any open square within 30 feet of your current position. You take no damage from this attack, which instead destroys your illusory duplicate (similar to mirror image). Using this ability requires a line of effect to the teleportation target square.

id-00006.name: Study Target (+3/+3)
id-00006.text:
A slayer can study an opponent he can see as a move action. The slayer then gains a +1 bonus on Bluff, Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, and Survival checks attempted against that opponent, and a +1 bonus on weapon attack and damage rolls against it. The DCs of slayer class abilities against that opponent increase by 1. A slayer can only maintain these bonuses against one opponent at a time; these bonuses remain in effect until either the opponent is dead or the slayer studies a new target.

If a slayer deals sneak attack damage to a target, he can study that target as an immediate action, allowing him to apply his studied target bonuses against that target (including to the normal weapon damage roll).

At 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th levels, the bonuses on weapon attack, damage rolls, and skill checks and to slayer DCs against a studied target increase by 1. In addition, at each such interval, the slayer is able to maintain these bonuses against an additional studied target at the same time. The slayer may discard this connection to a studied target as a free action, allowing him to study another target in its place.

At 7th level, a slayer can study an opponent as a move or swift action.

id-00013.name: Trickster Attack - Surprise Strike
id-00013.text: As a swift action, you can expend one use of mythic power to make a melee attack or ranged attack against a target within 30 feet, in addition to any other attacks you make this round. When you make a surprise strike, the target is considered flat-footed regardless of any class features or abilities it might have, and you add your tier to the attack roll. Damage from this attack bypasses damage reduction.

id-00017.benefit: When making a full-attack action with a bow, your first attack fires two arrows. If the attack hits, both arrows hit. Apply precision-based damage (such as sneak attack) and critical hit damage only once for this attack. Damage bonuses from using a composite bow with a high Strength bonus apply to each arrow, as do other damage bonuses, such as a ranger's favored enemy bonus. Damage reduction and resistances apply separately to each arrow.

id-00017.prerequisites: Dex 17, Point-Blank Shot, Rapid Shot, base attack bonus +6.
id-00017.text:
When making a full-attack, first attack fires 2 arrows at once.

If attack hits, roll damage twice. On Crit: Only multiply first arrow damage.

Precision damage (such as sneak attack) only applies once.

Damage bonuses (such as STR bonus) apply to each arrow.

Damage reduction apply to each arrow.
